A '''square''' was located in a [[Desix City|city]] on the [[planet]] [[Desix]]. It surrounded the [[Desix Bell Tower]] and had an inner wall that encircled the square with a large gap that acted as the main entrance to the square. The inner wall had at least 2 separate blast doors and contained lights that illuminated the wall. The climate of Desix meant that the square was occasionally swept by sandstorms.<ref name="Solitary" /> In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''</ref> it was under the control of a [[Desix Separatist holdout|Separatist holdout]] before it was taken over by the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Solitary" />

==History==
When an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Nu-class attack/transport shuttle|''Nu''-class attack/transport shuttle]] arrived at [[Desix City]], [[Governor]] [[Grotton]] and his [[Stormtrooper|TK trooper]] [[squad]] greeted the current governor, [[Tawni Ames]] at the square, where Grotton informed her that he would be replacing her as governor. Due to the Empire still not recognizing Desix as independent, Grotton and his squad were taken hostage by the [[Desix Separatist holdout|Separatist holdout]] using [[B1-series battle droid]]s. In the [[Mission to Desix]], after storming the city, [[Cody|CC-2224]] "Cody," [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair," and "[[Nova (clone trooper)|Nova]]" came across the city square where they initially encountered no resistance and infiltrated the bell tower. After Governor Grotton was rescued and Ames was executed by Crosshair, he ordered Cody and Crosshair to hang her body at the square to deter the inhabitants of a city from causing civil dissent. When the Galactic Empire arrived at the planet and occupied the city using TK Troopers, they rounded up at least 10 inhabitants of the city at the square.<ref name="Solitary" />

==Behind the scenes==
This location first appeared in [[The Bad Batch Season 2]] episode [[The Solitary Clone]] which was released on [[Disney+]] on[[January 11]], [[2023]].<ref name="Solitary" />
